description: Points your domain (and www) at your RV Park Planner booking website (A records for our main and standby servers) and adds a TXT record that proves you own the domain.
variableDescription: ip: the IPv4 address of the main RV Park Planner server (A records for the domain and www); ip2: the IPv4 address of the standby RV Park Planner server (second A records for the domain and www, used on failover); token: the one-time ownership code shown in RV Park Planner, without its rvpp- prefix (TXT record at _rvpp-verify, written as rvpp-<token>)
